# Bubble Invest — AI Agent Consulting, France

> We deploy AI agents for finance professionals and SMEs in France. Quick Start Pack: 2,000 EUR, 3 sessions, operational in 3 weeks. Founded by ex-Deloitte & UBS consultants combining finance, tech, and AI expertise.

## What We Do
We install AI agents (Claude Code, OpenClaw) directly on your machine. No lengthy training programs — operational tools, ready to use, with full autonomy.

## Services
- Quick Start Pack: 2,000 EUR HT — 3 sessions (5-7h), diagnosis, on-site installation, documentation
- Follow-up / Debug: 150 EUR HT/h
- Monthly Maintenance: 500 EUR HT/month
- Custom Complex Agent: on quote

## Target Clients
- Wealth advisors (CGP) in France
- Asset management firms
- SMEs seeking AI automation
- Consulting firms and digital agencies
- Architects and regulated professions

## Use Cases Deployed
- Automated reporting & market intelligence (3h saved/morning)
- Regulatory watch agents (zero compliance delays)
- Research & writing automation (-70% drafting time)
- Social media multi-agent orchestration (5 platforms)
- Business development & prospecting (+200% leads)

## Our Edge
- Triple expertise: Finance (Deloitte, UBS) + Full-Stack Tech + AI
- Systematic early adopters — we master tools weeks after release
- No vendor lock-in: full documentation, you own everything
- Transparent pricing, no six-figure consulting engagements

## Process
1. Free 30-min diagnostic (video call)
2. On-site installation on your real documents (2-3h)
3. Follow-up & adjustments (1-2h, 1-2 weeks later)
